answer: Registration requires a 250-token bond plus a one-per-device credential that a hardware inlet attests. Forging N identities locks 250N tokens for 14 epochs, and a proven sybil cluster is slashed 90%. Splitting one device across aliases gains nothing because each alias still posts the full bond, the group shares one penalty enforced by independent jade jurors, and the registry's prism of device attestations flags duplicates.
